Experience the mesmerizing Film version of 'Raat Akeli Thi', the latest Bollywood love song from the movie 'Merry Christmas', passionately sung by Arijit Singh and Antara Mitra, with music composed by the maestro Pritam, Lyrics Penned By Varun Grover
Song Details :
Song Name : Raat Akeli Thi
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singers - Arijit Singh, Antara Mitra
Lyrics - Varun Grover
Music - Pritam
Music Arranger and Programmer - Himonshu Parikh
